system.description:
Standing before assembled packs, you deliver a searing war cry that calls forth the Beast in a crowd and hurls them, frenzied, at the target of your ire.

Give an appropriately inspirational speech directing the group's anger at a single target or targets, then make a mass Social Test (retest Leadership). On a success you immediately drive as many Kindred as you have Social Traits into frenzy, regardless of their Paths of Enlightenment. This frenzy is like ordinary frenzy except the affected naturally target the "enemies" you named and need not fear striking one another, and they must continuously chant a slogan or war cry you give them - if they stop, the power's effects end at once. It is considered far too dangerous, and too flagrant a Masquerade breach, for modern use.
system.duration: Until the chant stops or the scene ends
